title: Componentwise Geometry and Monodromy of Generalized Lamé Equations
summary: We develop a componentwise geometric and monodromy theory for the one-support generalized Lamé equation on an elliptic curve, with singularities at \(0\) and \(\pm p\). Its log-free curve decomposes canonically into irreducible even and non-even components, the former being governed by elliptic Painlevé~VI.
